checked: Flow = debt-tracking streaming protocol: recipient withdraws accrued debt, sender deposits/refunds/pauses; no keeper or bounty role exists. Addresses from the Envio index the DefiLlama adapter queries (indexer.hyperindex.xyz/53b7e25, Contract where chainId=1 category=flow) plus docs.sablier.com/guides/flow/deployments (SablierFlow 0x844344cd871b28221d725ece9630e8bde4e3a181, flow-v3.0); all four have code (18,464-22,596 bytes) and name() = "Sablier Flow NFT" on chain: 0x844344cd871b28221d725ece9630e8bde4e3a181 (nextStreamId 12), 0x7a86d3e6894f9c5b5f25ffbdaae658cfc7569623 (55), 0x3df2aaede81d2f6b261f79047517713b8e844e04 (96), 0x2d9221a63e12aa796619cb381ec4a71b201281f5 (15) - 174 streams ever, matching the 380k USD TVL. Verified source via explorer (SablierFlow.sol + ISablierFlow.sol): user functions create/createAndDeposit/deposit/depositAndPause/pause/refund/refundAndPause/refundMax/restart/restartAndDeposit/adjustRatePerSecond are onlySender; recover is onlyComptroller; void requires sender/recipient/approved (eth_call void(22) from fresh 0x1111..1111 reverts 0xa9ad2a22 SablierFlow_Unauthorized); only withdraw(streamId,to,amount) and withdrawMax(streamId,to) are open to anyone, and they pay the RECIPIENT, not the caller (withdrawMax(22, caller) from a stranger reverts 0x4208ab4c WithdrawalAddressNotRecipient; withdrawMax(22, recipient) succeeds). The caller additionally must send msg.value >= calculateMinFeeWei (0 for streams 7 and 22 at block 26459626), so a stranger pays gas and maybe a fee and receives 0. transferFeesToComptroller() is permissionless but sweeps accumulated fees to the comptroller, not to the caller. Oldest deployment 0x2d92 (ABI via explorer) adds only collectProtocolRevenue (CallerNotAdmin) and a protocol/broker fee taken from the streamed amount - still no reward, claim, settle, harvest or bounty function in any version.
